name: Susan DeBay Jewelry & Leather
demographics: Susan DeBay Jewelry & Leather serves the Apple Valley community in San Bernardino County, attracting middle-income households and artisan craft enthusiasts. The trade area draws from the High Desert region's diverse population, including families, retirees, and working professionals seeking unique handcrafted jewelry and leather goods. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers aged 35-65 who appreciate personalized service and locally-made artisan products over mass-market alternatives.
description: Susan DeBay Jewelry & Leather is a distinctive artisan boutique located on Biltmore Road in Apple Valley, California, serving the High Desert community with handcrafted jewelry and leather goods. This independent specialty shop offers customers a personalized shopping experience with unique, handmade pieces that stand apart from typical mall retailers. Operating from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, the store has built a reputation for quality craftsmanship and individual attention to each customer's needs. With an active online presence through Etsy, Susan DeBay has expanded her reach beyond the local Apple Valley market while maintaining the intimate, boutique atmosphere that defines the physical location. The store represents the entrepreneurial spirit of small business owners in the Inland Empire region, offering residents access to distinctive artisan products and custom design services.
summary: Susan DeBay Jewelry & Leather is an artisan boutique in Apple Valley specializing in handcrafted jewelry and leather goods. This independent shop offers unique, personalized pieces and maintains both a physical storefront and an active Etsy online presence.
